study: non-normative EEE to AIREP Embedded Evaluation Profile semantic crosswalk

rows.value_source: source record plus explicit evaluator context
rows.loss_eee_to_airep: EEE source_type has no single profile field.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Evidence roles and engagement identity do not fit one EEE source block.
rows.claim_risk: Attributing a collector, harness, or publisher as the evaluator.

rows.value_source: EEE relationship is relative to model developer; AIREP independence is a declaration with basis.
rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Relationship category is not independence evidence.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Conflict disclosure and basis are lost.
rows.claim_risk: third_party becoming independent or verified.

rows.loss_eee_to_airep: EEE registry-resolution detail may be lost.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: provider/system_name may not split into EEE developer/name.
rows.claim_risk: Configured identity being described as executed identity.

rows.value_source: native run configuration or supplied digest bytes
rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Untyped additional details cannot safely choose revision vs checkpoint vs weights digest.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Typed identity assurance collapses into string details.
rows.claim_risk: A revision label being promoted to verified checkpoint execution.
sources: EEE real records and field guidance

rows.value_source: native run identity or deterministic mapping identity
rows.loss_eee_to_airep: EEE collection routing convention may be lost.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: None if uniqueness scope is documented.
rows.claim_risk: Invented IDs can be mistaken for upstream IDs.

rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Free-form additional details may not transfer.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Typed revision may become additional detail.
rows.claim_risk: Replacing an absent revision with current HEAD.

rows.loss_eee_to_airep: EEE detailed-result row count/format need separate retention.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: AIREP role, visibility and resolvability are not native EEE reference semantics.
rows.claim_risk: A reference string being treated as reachable or public.

rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Typed generation arguments are reduced to evidence/config digest.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Environment declarations are broader than generation config.
rows.claim_risk: A digest being presented as decoded configuration.

rows.loss_eee_to_airep: EEE source_data extensions may be lost.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: AIREP task configuration digest has no dedicated EEE field.
rows.claim_risk: Dataset name without revision/split can select different populations.

rows.value_source: native metric definition plus pinned registry guidance
rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Metric kind, unit, range and score type have no full profile destination.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Criterion statement/threshold is not a metric definition.
rows.claim_risk: Same metric label masking different implementations.

rows.airep: no dedicated equivalent; retain native evidence/limitations
rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Typed direction/range becomes external context.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Cannot be reconstructed generally.
rows.claim_risk: Reversing interpretation or assuming [0,1].
sources: AIREP profile has no metric-definition object

rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Argument names and values are not represented in the profile.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Not applicable.
rows.claim_risk: Omitted decoding/sampling settings can make results look comparable.

rows.eee: agent tools, sandbox and limit fields
rows.value_source: native evaluator runtime or explicit declaration
rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Per-agent typed limits/traces are coarser in AIREP.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Evaluator access tier is not agent runtime configuration.
rows.claim_risk: Conflating model tool access with evaluator access.

rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Score detail structure may be lost.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: AIREP observation status is separate and may be lost.
rows.claim_risk: Copying the wrong task/metric or rounding.

rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Typed uncertainty value/method is absent.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Not applicable.
rows.claim_risk: A point estimate appearing more certain after transformation.
sources: AIREP profile has no uncertainty field

rows.eee: raw score; no general predeclared criterion/PASS field
rows.loss_eee_to_airep: A raw score cannot supply criterion chronology or verdict.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Criterion, assessment author and PASS/FAIL are lost.
rows.claim_risk: Criterion laundering and attribution of a downstream judgment to evaluator.

rows.eee: no aggregate equivalent with AIREP state semantics
rows.loss_eee_to_airep: File/result presence cannot distinguish all states.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: RAN/PARTIAL/NOT_RUN/INVALIDATED semantics are not preserved structurally.
rows.claim_risk: Run completion becoming metric PASS or missing becoming zero.

rows.eee: aggregate record plus optional instance-level JSONL
rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Instance semantics remain opaque evidence bytes.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Not applicable.
rows.claim_risk: Treating EEE messages/tool calls as AIREP lifecycle stages.

rows.eee: sample counts/details and source_data; conventions vary
rows.value_source: native evaluated rows or explicit declaration
rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Population and denominator semantics can be lost.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Limitations are not a typed denominator.
rows.claim_risk: max_samples cap becoming exact or complete coverage.

rows.eee: instance rows and source-specific invalid/error states
rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Per-instance failures can be aggregated away.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Disclosure records do not map to result rows.
rows.claim_risk: Dropping exclusions, failed attempts or retries changes denominator.

rows.value_source: reported checksum or recomputation over named bytes
rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Reported-vs-recomputed origin is not automatic.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Evidence role/visibility/resolvability are lost.
rows.claim_risk: Copying a checksum as if the destination recomputed the retrieved bytes.

rows.eee: file_path/source references and real-record missing/unknown conventions
rows.value_source: current retrieval observation or explicit custodian declaration
rows.loss_eee_to_airep: A path alone says nothing about later availability.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Visibility/withholding semantics have no dedicated EEE equivalent.
rows.claim_risk: restricted, unavailable or unknown evidence becoming public/resolvable.

rows.eee: no aggregate field with the same evaluator-access semantics
rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Cannot be inferred from model availability/deployment fields.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Typed access distinctions collapse.
rows.claim_risk: Open weights becoming white-box evaluation access.

rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Independence cannot be inferred.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Status, conflict statement and basis are lost.
rows.claim_risk: Declared independence being reworded as verified identity/independence.

rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Unknown must remain unknown.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Typed state/evidence refs collapse.
rows.claim_risk: Silence becoming safeguards present or absent.

rows.eee: no aggregate equivalent for the full set
rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Cannot infer absence from missing fields.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Typed disclosure entries are lost.
rows.claim_risk: Undisclosed retry/redaction state making evidence look complete.

rows.loss_eee_to_airep: No generic EEE field can be treated as scope boundary.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Positive and negative scope distinction collapses.
rows.claim_risk: A narrow measurement becoming a model-wide claim.

rows.loss_eee_to_airep: No later verification may be inferred.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Kind/status/independence are lost.
rows.claim_risk: Platform token or schema validation becoming independent verification.

rows.eee: single_turn/multi_turn/agentic messages, tool calls and answer attribution
rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Interaction structure and attribution are opaque.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Not applicable.
rows.claim_risk: Relabeling trace events as AIREP lifecycle artifacts.

rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Typed token/latency measurements are not represented.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Not applicable.
rows.claim_risk: Omitted performance differences can undermine comparability.

rows.value_source: producer-specific EEE value or explicit offset-bearing run window
rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Epoch/ISO value may identify a different event and timezone semantics may be absent.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Run interval collapses to one ambiguous field.
rows.claim_risk: Silently treating local/epoch/ISO text as UTC run time.

rows.airep: target identity plus optional verification references
rows.value_source: configuration is distinct from verification evidence
rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Strings do not prove executed bytes.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Verification qualification is lost.
rows.claim_risk: Configured revision becoming verified execution identity.

rows.value_source: requires a criterion, comparator, chronology and assessment author
rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Raw value cannot establish verdict.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Verdict rationale disappears if only score is retained.
rows.claim_risk: Threshold invention or evaluator misattribution.

rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Validator-specific semantic checks differ.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: JSON Schema result differs from EEE Pydantic/publication checks.
rows.claim_risk: Structural validation being reworded as truth, safety or interoperability.

rows.airep: explicit unknown enums, limitations and disclosure
rows.value_source: actual field semantics and producer provenance
rows.loss_eee_to_airep: Missing, literal unknown and inferred provenance are not interchangeable.
rows.loss_airep_to_eee: Explicit limitation/disclosure can collapse to absence.
rows.claim_risk: Treating missing as false, unknown as known-unavailable, or inferred as source-reported.

non_claims: The formats are not asserted to be equivalent or interoperable.
Neither schema validation establishes result truth, model safety, identity, completeness or reproducibility.
This is not EvalEval adoption, endorsement or an official converter.
The claim-preservation Internet-Draft is an analytical lens, not an EEE requirement.
